speech.israel_simulator.bibi_boss.quote_: "Together we will win! The coalition stands firm and unbroken!"
"I have guided this land through storm and sun. You cannot unseat me!"
"No weapon formed against our podium shall prosper! Filibuster!"
speech.israel_simulator.bibi_boss.missil: Bibi: "Incoming air strike! Seek immediate shelter!"
speech.israel_simulator.trump.wall_of_mo: Trump: "We have so much money! Look at this wall, nobody builds walls like me!"
speech.israel_simulator.trump.call_ice: Trump: "ICE, get in here! Deport these bad hombres!"
speech.israel_simulator.trump.quote_0: "This is the greatest, most tremendous coalition deal in history!"
speech.israel_simulator.trump.quote_1: "Nobody knows defense better than me, believe me, huge crowd!"
speech.israel_simulator.trump.quote_2: "Fake news! We're doing numbers like nobody has ever seen before!"
speech.israel_simulator.epstein.summon_k: Epstein: "Come out, little friends! Defend my private sanctuary!"
speech.israel_simulator.epstein.quote_0: "I know people in very high places! You'll never get away with this!"
speech.israel_simulator.epstein.quote_1: "My island records are sealed! You cannot audit me!"

commands.israel_simulator.speech.already: A Public Speech is already running
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_0: "Welcome, friends! This square belongs to everyone who wants to speak and listen."
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_1: "Free speech means you may disagree with me, loudly if you like!"
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_2: "A city is stronger when its people talk to each other, not past each other."
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_3: "Listen first, reply second. That's the whole secret of a good debate."
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_4: "From the market stalls to the seafront, every voice adds to the city's song."
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_5: "Words build bridges faster than any engineer. Choose yours well!"
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_6: "Ask questions, share ideas, and buy a falafel for whoever you argue with."
speech.israel_simulator.orator.line_7: "Thank you for staying! Keep the square open and the conversation going."
